## Description

Estimates real-time synthetic Intraday Net Asset Value (iNAV) from underlying constituents and trades ETF dislocations using passive limit orders when dislocation exceeds bid-ask spread.

## Where it may fit

Intraday ETF mispricings, market open/close volatility spikes, wide constituent spread environments.

## Vehicles

Authorized Participant (AP) trading desks, ETF market makers, quantitative multi-asset desks.

## Required data

Level 1/2 real-time quotes for ETF and all top underlying constituent holdings, daily basket weights.

## Caveats

Must execute strictly with passive limit orders at bid/ask to avoid crossing spreads and paying taker fees; mandatory end-of-day position liquidation.
